summary: Improve enrolment, eligibility, reconciliation, and grievance workflows. Explore the five-day course and its practical administration tools.
lede: Social protection benefits administration covers the workflows that take people from enrolment through eligibility decisions, payment reconciliation and grievance resolution. It is for programme operations managers, registry specialists, eligibility and payment officers, and digital-registry teams responsible for benefit delivery. Participants practise mapping workflows, reviewing eligibility cases, checking payment records, tracking grievances and using data-quality checks and operational dashboards to identify improvements.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for the day-to-day administration, control, and digital operation of social protection benefits.
prerequisites: Familiarity with social protection programme delivery or public-service operations is useful. No coding is required. Bring a laptop with spreadsheet software; exercises can use a supplied synthetic practice dataset and templates.
